17748478-21b7-4400-ae1f-363effe5688e@ufc.why: Ciryl Gane makes the first defense of the heavyweight title he claimed after Tom Aspinall vacated it due to an eye injury, facing undefeated prospect Josh Hokit, who jumped from UFC debutant to title challenger in one year. In the co-main, bantamweight champion Kayla Harrison defends her belt in a huge comeback fight against Amanda Nunes, a former two-division champion returning after a long layoff, with two titles on the line in one night at MSG.
17748478-21b7-4400-ae1f-363effe5688e@ufc.know: A "title defense" means the champion keeps fighting to prove they still deserve the belt, while a number ranking (like #4) shows how UFC rates contenders in that weight class. Being a "two-division champion" means Nunes once held belts in two different weight classes at the same time, a rare feat showing elite versatility.

b0ab8af8-cb28-465a-aea7-5d32bec5ae19@nin.why: The 49ers are 7-1 and sitting atop the NFC West, the strongest record in their division this year. Dallas is a middling 3-5 team, so this is a good chance for San Francisco to pad its division lead. No playoff spot is clinched or lost here, it is simply one more step toward a strong playoff seed.
b0ab8af8-cb28-465a-aea7-5d32bec5ae19@nin.know: It is only Week 10, so one game will not decide anyone's season. Instead watch how the 49ers handle a mediocre opponent on the road, and track injuries to running back Christian McCaffrey and receiver Deebo Samuel, both nursing hamstring issues, plus tight end George Kittle, a key target in the short passing game Dallas's coach has flagged as hard to stop.
